final: WITH j AS (SELECT o.mktnote AS m, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), p AS (SELECT m, AVG(net) AS a FROM j GROUP BY m), b AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS bench FROM p) SELECT AVG(p.a) AS avg_net_rate_above, AVG(p.a - b.bench) AS avg_excess FROM p, b WHERE p.a > b.bench
